title: feat(AdvancedPaste): add PasteAsKeystrokes format and functionality

proposed_comments.title: Report keystroke cancellation to the caller
Harden generated input semantics
Keep the keystroke format out of Semantic Kernel registration
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the keystroke format out of Semantic Kernel registration

**Severity:** `high`

`PasteAsKeystrokes` has no AI execution path, so it should not expose a kernel function description. Pin the enum member to its persisted value at the same time so the remaining telemetry-preserving assignments can be applied directly.

```suggestion
    [PasteFormatMetadata(
        IsCoreAction = true,
        ResourceId = "PasteAsKeystrokes",
        IconGlyph = "\uE765",
        RequiresAIService = false,
        CanPreview = false,
        SupportedClipboardFormats = ClipboardFormat.Text)]
    PasteAsKeystrokes = 11,
```
proposed_comments.current_note: The posted value-11 hunk predates current main. A future author rebase must preserve FixSpellingAndGrammar=3 through CustomTextTransformation=11 and use PasteAsKeystrokes=12; the converged fork also pins explicit display order.

proposed_comments.title: Surface canceled or failed keystroke pastes
Wait for the target editor to exit before reading the file
proposed_comments.body:
### Wait for the target editor to exit before reading the file

**Severity:** `medium`

The test kills Notepad and immediately reads the file, which races the target process's final save and flush on slower machines. Waiting for the process to exit removes that shutdown timing hole and matches the reviewed fix.

```suggestion
            process.Kill(true);
            process.WaitForExit();
```

proposed_comments.title: Complete shortcut wiring and preserve persisted format values
proposed_comments.body:
A few follow-ups still need manual edits to make the new Paste as Keystrokes path complete. GitHub can't offer an apply button here because some of the required changes are in files outside this PR diff.

- Please finish wiring the shortcut into `src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/Helpers/PowerToysShortcutsPopulator.cs`, `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/DashboardViewModel.cs`, and `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/AdvancedPasteViewModel.cs`:
```csharp
content.Append(HotkeySettingsToYaml(
    advancedPasteProperties.PasteAsKeystrokeShortcut,
    SettingsResourceLoader.GetString("AdvancedPaste/ModuleTitle"),
    SettingsResourceLoader.GetString("PasteAsKeystrokes_Shortcut/Header")));
```

```csharp
if (moduleSettingsRepository.SettingsConfig.Properties.PasteAsKeystrokeShortcut.GetKeysList().Count > 0)
{
    list.Add(new DashboardModuleShortcutItem()
    {
        Label = resourceLoader.GetString("PasteAsKeystrokes_Shortcut/Header"),
        Shortcut = moduleSettingsRepository.SettingsConfig.Properties.PasteAsKeystrokeShortcut.GetKeysList()
    });
}
```

```csharp
public bool IsConflictingCopyShortcut =>
    _customActions.Select(customAction => customAction.Shortcut)
        .Concat([PasteAsPlainTextShortcut, AdvancedPasteUIShortcut, PasteAsMarkdownShortcut, PasteAsJsonShortcut, PasteAsKeystrokeShortcut])
        .Any(hotkey => WarnHotkeys.Contains(hotkey.ToString()));
```
